Todo excelente. Habitación muy limpia y bien equipada con frigobar, camas súper cómodas, buena presión de agua. Botella de agua mineral y caramelos de cortesía al llegar. Incluye desayuno en e YPF Full. Cochera techada junto a la habitación.

(Translated by Google)
Everything was excellent. The room was very clean and well-equipped with a mini-fridge, super comfortable beds, and good water pressure. A complimentary bottle of mineral water and candies were provided upon arrival. Breakfast at the YPF Full gas station is included. There is covered parking next to the room.
